basic_info.headline: Software Engineer||Builder of Solutions
basic_info.about: Growing up with a father who is an artist, I was motivated to partake in my own creative pursuits by utilizing my skills in Adobe Suite for many different clients, designing personal logos, websites, and custom merchandise. As I grew older, I became curious about the engineering aspects of everyday items, and I garnered an interest in complex technical projects. I’ve worked on numerous ventures, from designing underwater robots to building lighting systems fully powered by solar panels. As a software engineer, I aim to combine my love for art with my passion for technology and bringing modern systems to underdeveloped communities. I look forward to contributing to a team that seeks to find strong solutions to big problems.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description:
-Developed visually captivating and highly responsive websites, delivering exceptional user experiences across various devices and screen sizes.
-Skillfully identified and resolved bugs and code issues, ensuring optimal performance and seamless functionality of applications.
-Successfully collaborated within cross-functional teams of 25 members to develop full-stack applications, leveraging collective expertise and fostering a cohesive work environment.
-Demonstrated effective communication and teamwork skills, contributing to the timely completion of projects while meeting client requirements.
-Utilized industry-standard tools such as git and GitHub to track and maintain project progress, facilitating seamless collaboration and efficient workflow management.
-Ensured version control and efficient code integration, resulting in streamlined development processes and enhanced project organization.
Projects
Client Site:

Created a dynamic and engaging client website showcasing the company's services, contact information, and impressive portfolio, effectively promoting the company's offerings to potential clients.

LevelGround:

Developed a captivating client website, effectively presenting comprehensive information about the company's workout plans and facilitating easy enrollment in fitness classes, contributing to increased customer engagement and conversion rates.

JWLI:

-Designed and developed an informative client website, effectively conveying the company's mission statement, founders' profiles, and notable achievements, contributing to improved brand awareness and customer trust.

experience.title: Graphic Designer
experience.description:
-Conducted in-depth consultations with clients to understand their specific requirements, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of their brand identity and objectives.
-Leveraged strong communication and active listening skills to gather valuable insights, enabling the creation of tailored solutions that met and exceeded client expectations.
-Utilized a keen eye for aesthetics and design principles to create a visually stunning and impactful logo, aligning it seamlessly with the client's brand identity and vision.
-Employed creativity and innovative thinking to craft a captivating graphic that served as the company's primary visual representation, leaving a lasting impression on target audiences.

experience.title: Graphic Web Designer
experience.description:
-Collaborated closely with clients to identify their specific brand requirements and assisted in finding robust and cost-effective solutions that aligned with their goals and budgetary constraints.
-Utilized a comprehensive understanding of branding principles to offer tailored recommendations, ensuring clients achieved a strong and impactful brand presence within their industry.
-Utilized Adobe Photoshop to design visually appealing wireframes for an eCommerce site, effectively translating conceptual ideas into tangible representations.
-Demonstrated a keen eye for aesthetics and user experience, creating wireframes that captured the essence of the final design and provided a clear roadmap for the development process.
-Collaborated with clients to offer guidance and support in making informed product choices, ensuring the selection aligned with their brand image, target audience, and market trends.
-Strategically positioned products on the website, considering factors such as visual hierarchy, user flow, and maximizing conversions, resulting in an optimized user experience and increased sales potential.
